sections.whatsHappening: You must give the municipality written notice of your claim. This notice must include details of the injury, including the date, time, and location of the occurrence. You must serve this notice on the clerk of the municipality.
sections.whatToDoNext: Prepare your written notice. You can serve it on the clerk in person or send it by registered mail.
sections.yourDeadline:
Give written notice of the claim to the clerk of the municipality. You have 10 days, counted from the occurrence of the injury.

This deadline is set by a statute rather than by the court's rules, and that changes how the days are counted. Under the rules a deadline landing on a Saturday moves to the next working day. Under the statute it does not — only Sunday and holidays are excluded. Do not assume a weekend gives you extra time.
sections.whatHappensAfter: After you give notice, you can consider filing a claim in Small Claims Court if you choose to proceed.
